candidates.sourceClaim: Guide groups Reactive Barrier among defensive responses; source tooltip describes a control-triggered barrier.
candidates.hypothesis: A barrier triggered by Abrams control may cushion follow-up damage.
candidates.limits: Does not stop the charge or guarantee survival; cooldown/trigger timing matter. Wiki numerical fields conflict.
candidates.nextCheck: Corroborate exact Abrams control trigger, barrier damage coverage and ordering against current mechanics or a reproducible test.

candidates.sourceClaim: Wiki lists Abrams stuns among affected controls; client tooltip describes negative-effect duration reduction.
candidates.hypothesis: Reduced stun duration may permit an earlier response.
candidates.limits: No guaranteed parry window; rank, duration items, spacing and latency remain unresolved.
candidates.nextCheck: Check current Shoulder Charge and Seismic Impact control durations; test the heavy-melee timing claim separately.

candidates.sourceClaim: Guide includes Debuff Reducer in its cleanse/removal group.
candidates.hypothesis: The guide grouping could be mistaken for removal of existing effects.
candidates.limits: Captured tooltip supports duration reduction, not on-demand removal. Do not implement a cleanse rule.
candidates.nextCheck: Keep duration reduction and cleanse as separate effects; reject broad guide-category inference.

candidates.sourceClaim: Commenters suggest Dispel Magic for applied Shiv knife debuffs.
candidates.hypothesis: Removal of eligible knife effects may reduce ongoing damage and create recovery space.
candidates.limits: Not verified execute prevention. Captured tooltip excludes ultimate debuffs and use while stunned/slept; reapplication remains possible.
candidates.nextCheck: Find current specific Serrated Knives removal evidence; model damage-over-time separately from burst before publishing.

candidates.sourceClaim: Community recommends healing reduction against sustain-heavy Abrams/Shiv; client item applies healing reduction through spirit damage.
candidates.hypothesis: Healbane may help Infernus finish healing enemies when he can maintain application.
candidates.limits: Does not establish burst survival or execute prevention; damage deferral is not healing. Application, stacking and affected healing need review.
candidates.nextCheck: Map each hero healing source and verify application/refresh conditions; keep punish separate from survive.

candidates.sourceClaim: Guide places Toxic Bullets among anti-heal options; source tooltip describes bullet buildup, bleed and healing reduction.
candidates.hypothesis: A sustained bullet application option may deny relevant healing.
candidates.limits: Not instant application or immediate protection; utility can justify a weapon item, but weapon uptime and opportunity cost need review.
candidates.nextCheck: Verify buildup thresholds, hero application suitability and affected healing before assigning stages or strength.

candidates.sourceClaim: A commenter lists Counterspell against Shiv ultimate; source item uses a timed parry response.
candidates.hypothesis: A correctly timed spell parry might stop a specific ultimate interaction.
candidates.limits: No current interaction proof or timing test collected. Do not promise execute immunity or rescue after control.
candidates.nextCheck: Obtain direct current Killing Blow interaction evidence and activation-window test; broad item wording alone is insufficient.

candidates.sourceClaim: Community describes Unstoppable as control protection; source tooltip prevents specified controls but disallows use while stunned/slept.
candidates.hypothesis: Preemptive use may protect against relevant Abrams control.
candidates.limits: Expensive future purchase, not a reactive button after stun. Damage protection and each displacement interaction require separate evidence.
candidates.nextCheck: Verify specific charge/ultimate behavior and preemptive timing; do not equate control immunity with damage immunity.
